commits.summary: Replay original application fixtures and complete Maven modules (verification pending)
commits.body:
Bind both sides of each caller observation to the original source fixtures and ordered runtime artifacts. Preserve partial outcomes, exception causes and original frames when a later input fails. The complete-module preparation includes generated classes, processed resources and reactor prerequisites. Correct the missing-list oracle and the generated classes used to check SourceFile metadata. The real logging backend is an explicit assumption of the ZT-exec claim.

Checked 25 scope files, four fixture digests against both Git revisions, five runtime companion declarations and their applicable upstream versions. All 27 selected Python groups passed, including the caller-entry and fixture controls. A watcher timing test passed on retry. The queued checks use real spreadsheet, Wire, Guice, profiler, bytecode, reporting, QR, constructor and FTP clients.

Verification jobs 20261121-051151-caller-recovery-1-check-original-fixture, 20261121-051151-caller-recovery-2-check-original-fixture, 20261121-051151-complete-modules-1-materialize-original, 20261121-051152-complete-modules-2-materialize-original, 20261121-051152-complete-modules-3-materialize-original, 20261121-051152-complete-modules-4-materialize-original, 20261121-052300-transfer-applications-replay-original-qr.

commits.summary: Follow normal and throwing paths through declared checked exceptions (verification pending)
commits.body:
The before-and-after Java harness already catches the throwables escaping each call. Let it compare eligible methods that declare checked exceptions. A new control changes IOException to EOFException on one input and preserves the returned value on its companion. The native checker finds the first input and proves the companion. Separate JVMs reproduce both exception classes and the returned value.

All 24 pairing tests passed. All 58 Rust test binaries and all 10 selected test groups passed, and the test inventory lint is clean. Job 20261121-053029-352-compare-original-formatter-paths-pas reruns the original Cucumber duration native proof beyond the former declaration refusal. Its finite 18-input proof is recorded separately.

commits.summary: Record original CI, CompCheck and qualified caller outcomes for 32 upgrades (verification pending)
commits.body:
All 64 original module builds and 32 focused historical builds have receipts. Ten original developer tests passed before and failed after. Run stock CompCheck on its nine registered sites and record the leave-incident-out result. Reviewers can inspect each original revision, testcase, checked domain and finite JVM witness. The main corpus now reproduces the ReflectASM and profiler changes and establishes all twelve routine observations. Four of eight transfer cases have relevant outcomes. Preserved historical cases remain explicitly reported.

Validated all 32 paired CI records, all 16 focused pairs and all four applicable CompCheck inputs against the pinned source revisions. The report independently rechecks both trials, both original classpaths, each selected entry and the old expectations before grading. Original calibration receipts establish all 156 CSV and all 18 duration results. The affected test run passed 10 of 10 groups and all 58 Rust binaries.

Jobs 20261121-050135-350-exhaust-both-original-application-in, 20261121-050135-351-exhaust-both-original-application-in check the two input choices in the Rocker and AWS disclosed calibrations.

commits.summary: Qualify framework callbacks on the live application stack (verification pending)
commits.body:
A reviewed observation can call a public entry that synchronously reaches the selected original method. The breakpoint requires the target, prescribed caller and observer on the same thread stack on every repetition. An unrelated earlier call cannot qualify. Supply original provider registrations, record elapsed time on open cases, bind additional caller sources, and retain the original release tags and declared public Maven repositories for historical builds.

The checked Nacos Spring setup reached the original property-source callback twice for each of two values before the upgrade. The new side failed on the missing ErrorCoded class before reaching that callback. A separate bounded probe classified a real FTP file, directory and missing path on both Commons Net versions. All 28 affected test groups passed, including positive and dormant-wrapper controls. Validated 29 scopes with 11 original fixture bindings and six runtime companion declarations. Verified the original Apollo tag parents and resolved the published Togglz metadata at its declared JBoss endpoint.

Jobs 20261121-054619-apollo-original-guice-services-and-tagge, 20261121-054619-togglz-original-deltaspike-callback-and, 20261121-054619-observe-spring-configuration-callbacks-a, 20261121-054619-separate-outbound-wire-serialization-and prepare complete applications and compare the registered and additional original caller observations.

commits.summary: Keep typed JVM observations intact in applications that write concurrent logs (verification pending)
commits.body:
Nacos exposed a truncated UTF-16 observation when console logging overlapped the application result. Write the adapter result and its exception record into an exclusive file for the fresh JVM. Keep class-load diagnostics and the trusted stack-hit marker on separate streams. A regression makes the application print counterfeit result-shaped log lines and checks the real returned value.

Release the completed Maven mirror socket between original revisions. The original compile lifecycle can retain production classes and resources even when an optional packaging plugin cannot resolve its historical dependencies. Tested real consecutive mirror sessions and the caller-return plus missing-callback controls. All 27 selected Python groups passed.

Jobs 20261121-055302-rebuild-both-original-apollo-modules-in and 20261121-055303-compile-original-togglz-and-check-its-co repeat the affected original builds. The pinned corpus repeat will check Nacos with the isolated return channel.

commits.summary: Record original framework and calibration results and check five recovered modules (verification pending)
commits.body:
The original phone response decoder preserved its output. The separate outbound Wire converter raised NoSuchMethodError, and opening the actual spreadsheet raised IncompatibleClassChangeError before reading a style. The restored Apollo Git tags reproduce its original named test. The new Nacos context fails before property-source precedence can be checked. A real FTP file, directory and missing path preserve their types. Rocker diagnostic equality is refuted, the AWS public round trip is preserved and the native duration proof stops at Jackson Class.forName after the checked-exception repair.

Imported the original collector results and digests, including failed and partial attempts. Independent module preparation restored five paired production inputs unavailable to V0. Job 20261121-060355-pinned-v1-native-recovery-on-five-comple checks those five with the frozen V1 binary separately from the native repeat on the 32 matched inputs.

commits.summary: Report pinned V1 decisions on all 32 original Java dependency upgrades
commits.body:
Against V0 with no accepted decisions, V1 independently replays 2 of 12 registered main changes and establishes all 12 finite main preservation claims. On eight transfer clients V1 alone succeeds on five, two in represented families and three in new ones. All approved outcomes are engineering-assisted finite JVM results. The proposed gate for a three-team pilot remains unmet.

Separate original observations reproduce the Retrofit outbound serialization failure and spreadsheet workbook-opening failure while preserving the registered response/worksheet-style distinction. Both original artifacts became available for 29 of 32 pairs. The report names the first open step, historical CI and next review action for every case, including budget and measurement limits.

The frozen native binary ran on all 32 pairs and on five additional complete-module inputs. Rechecked 27 reviewed caller scopes, all 64 original CI receipts, all 32 focused historical CI receipts, both supplemental original witnesses, the portable source manifest and all 12 tool/JDK digests. All nine final pipeline jobs, all 58 Rust test binaries, both report-related Python groups and all five disclosed example validators passed. Original receipts, prior open attempts and the failed native Cucumber proof are retained.
